suggestions: parseQty uses Number(), so the box accepts 1.0, 1e2, 0x10, and integers above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER as a different JSON integer. The engine rejects a JSON float such as 1.0. Accept only a canonical digit string and send that integer; send anything else through unchanged so the backend returns 正整数.
